question: Under what condition may a teacher bestow the teaching that grants long life?
premises: The recipient must be thoroughly examined.
This examination should be done always or carefully.
Only then may the teacher give what grants long life.
inference: The teacher may bestow the life-giving teaching only after careful examination of the recipient.
uncertainties: The object cirajīvitam may refer literally to long life or metaphorically to a life-giving teaching.
plain_english: Having always examined him well, one may give to him that which grants long life.
